# Raw Read Retrieval and Workflow Compatibility Assessment for GEO Series GSE309890

## Abstract

GEO series GSE309890 was queried to determine whether its underlying raw sequencing reads could be retrieved and used for genome assembly. The GEO record (via `geo_series`) resolved to BioProject PRJNA1363958, an *Escherichia coli* str. K-12 substr. MG1655 (taxid 511145) study using high-throughput RNA sequencing, with 6 samples (3 sertraline-adapted, 3 control). `ncbi_sra_runs_for_project` returned all 6 associated SRA runs (SRR36018640–SRR36018645), each paired-end Illumina HiSeq 4000 data, ~300 bp mean read length, 10.4–12.0 million spot pairs and 3.1–3.6 Gb per run (801–955 MB compressed), all library source TRANSCRIPTOMIC / strategy RNA-Seq. Because the reads are RNA-Seq (cDNA) rather than whole-genome DNA-Seq, a de novo genome assembly is not the appropriate downstream analysis; the IWC workflow catalog's single ASSEMBLY-category workflow ("Assembly polishing with long reads") additionally requires long reads and an existing draft assembly to polish, neither of which this dataset provides. A complete reference genome for this exact strain already exists (GCF_000005845.2, 4,641,652 bp, 1 scaffold, haploid, "Complete Genome" level), and `check_compatibility` confirmed the paired-end RNA-Seq quantification workflow (`rnaseq-pe-main`) is compatible with it, with the reference FASTA/GTF automatically resolved. Raw reads can be downloaded and analyzed, but as RNA-Seq quantification against the existing reference, not as a genome assembly.

## I. Introduction

**Background.** *Escherichia coli* str. K-12 substr. MG1655 is a fully sequenced, extensively studied model bacterium (taxid 511145) with a single complete circular chromosome (GCF_000005845.2, 4,641,652 bp). GEO series link processed expression data to raw reads deposited in SRA under a linked BioProject, which is the standard path for reproducing or reanalyzing transcriptomic experiments.

**Literature Review.** No PubMed record is linked to this GEO series (`pubmed_ids: []`; GEO explicitly notes "No PubMed record is linked to this GEO record... typically an unpublished or not-yet-indexed study"). No literature was retrieved for this query.

**Knowledge Gap.** It was unresolved (a) which raw SRA runs underlie GSE309890, (b) what sequencing type and layout they represent, and (c) whether a genome-assembly workflow is technically applicable to this dataset given an existing reference genome for the organism.

**Objective & Hypothesis.** The objective was to retrieve the raw reads for GSE309890 and evaluate whether a genome assembly workflow can legitimately be run on them. The implicit expectation to test was that the reads are suitable input for assembly; the retrieved metadata was used to confirm or reject this.

## II. Materials and Methods

**Study Design.** The GEO record was first resolved to its BioProject, then to its SRA runs, to obtain read-level metadata (library strategy, layout, platform, size). In parallel, the organism's reference assembly and the IWC workflow catalog were queried to identify assembly-capable workflows and check their compatibility with the reference genome and read type.

**Materials.**
- NCBI GEO (`geo_series`)
- NCBI SRA (`ncbi_sra_runs_for_project`)
- NCBI Taxonomy (`ncbi_taxonomy_lookup`)
- NCBI BioProject (`ncbi_bioproject_summary`)
- BRC Analytics genome assembly catalog (`get_assemblies`)
- BRC Analytics IWC workflow catalog (`list_workflow_categories`, `get_workflows_in_category`, `get_compatible_workflows`, `check_compatibility`, `resolve_workflow_inputs`)
- BRC Analytics organism search (`search_organisms`) — returned no match for the free-text query used.

**Procedures (in order executed):**
1. `geo_series(accession="GSE309890", list_files=true)` — retrieved series metadata, 6 samples, BioProject PRJNA1363958.
2. `ncbi_sra_runs_for_project(accession="PRJNA1363958")` — retrieved all 6 linked SRA runs.
3. `ncbi_taxonomy_lookup(query="Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655")` — confirmed taxid 511145.
4. `ncbi_bioproject_summary(ids="1363958")` — confirmed project data type "Transcriptome or Gene expression" and design ("RNA-seq profiling of Escherichia coli MG1655 after 40 days of adaptive evolution under 40 mg/L sertraline").
5. `search_organisms(query="Escherichia coli K-12 MG1655")` — 0 matches (BRC organism index does not carry this exact string).
6. `list_workflow_categories()` — enumerated categories; ASSEMBLY has 1 workflow.
7. `get_compatible_workflows(ploidies=["haploid"], taxonomy_id="511145")` — 14 compatible workflows listed, including RNA-Seq and the single assembly-polishing workflow.
8. `get_workflows_in_category(category="ASSEMBLY")` — confirmed the sole assembly workflow is "Assembly polishing with long reads" (`polish-with-long-reads-main`), which requires an existing draft assembly FASTA plus long reads as input, not raw short paired-end reads for de novo assembly.
9. `get_assemblies(taxonomy_id="511145")` — retrieved reference assembly GCF_000005845.2.
10. `check_compatibility(iwc_id="rnaseq-pe-main", accession="GCF_000005845.2")` and `check_compatibility(iwc_id="polish-with-long-reads-main", accession="GCF_000005845.2")` — both returned compatible=true.
11. `resolve_workflow_inputs(iwc_id="rnaseq-pe-main", accession="GCF_000005845.2")` — resolved reference FASTA/GTF; only the paired FASTQ collection remains unresolved (user-supplied).

**Statistical Analysis.** Run counts (6) are a direct count of records returned by `ncbi_sra_runs_for_project` for BioProject PRJNA1363958, with no deduplication needed (one run per library/GSM). Base pairs and spot counts are taken verbatim from the `bases` and `spots` fields of the SRA runinfo table. File sizes are from the `size_MB` field. No percentages were derived; all figures are direct field values, not proportions of a larger denominator.

## III. Results

**Table 1. SRA runs linked to GSE309890 (BioProject PRJNA1363958)**

| Run | GSM (Sample) | Library strategy | Layout | Platform | Spots | Bases | Size (MB) |

| SRR36018645 | GSM9284457 (control, rep1) | RNA-Seq | PAIRED | Illumina HiSeq 4000 | 11,621,726 | 3,486,517,800 | 917 |
| SRR36018644 | GSM9284458 (control, rep2) | RNA-Seq | PAIRED | Illumina HiSeq 4000 | 10,415,434 | 3,124,630,200 | 801 |
| SRR36018643 | GSM9284459 (control, rep3) | RNA-Seq | PAIRED | Illumina HiSeq 4000 | 11,720,219 | 3,516,065,700 | 926 |
| SRR36018642 | GSM9284460 (adaptive evolution 40d, rep1) | RNA-Seq | PAIRED | Illumina HiSeq 4000 | 11,992,461 | 3,597,738,300 | 955 |
| SRR36018641 | GSM9284461 (adaptive evolution 40d, rep2) | RNA-Seq | PAIRED | Illumina HiSeq 4000 | 11,997,182 | 3,599,154,600 | 948 |
| SRR36018640 | GSM9284462 (adaptive evolution 40d, rep3) | RNA-Seq | PAIRED | Illumina HiSeq 4000 | 11,363,329 | 3,408,998,700 | 894 |

**Table 2. Workflow / reference compatibility check**

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Organism taxid | 511145 (*E. coli* str. K-12 substr. MG1655) |
| Reference assembly | GCF_000005845.2, Complete Genome, 1 scaffold, haploid, 4,641,652 bp |
| IWC ASSEMBLY-category workflows available | 1 ("Assembly polishing with long reads"; requires an existing draft FASTA + long reads) |
| `polish-with-long-reads-main` compatible with GCF_000005845.2 | true |
| `rnaseq-pe-main` (RNA-Seq quantification) compatible with GCF_000005845.2 | true |
| Unresolved input for `rnaseq-pe-main` | Paired FASTQ collection (user must supply the 6 SRA runs above) |

**Findings.** All 6 runs are paired-end, transcriptomic (cDNA), RNA-Seq library source, not whole-genome DNA sequencing. No genomic (WGS) runs are present in PRJNA1363958. The IWC catalog contains exactly 1 workflow in the ASSEMBLY category, and it performs long-read polishing of an already-existing draft assembly rather than de novo genome assembly from short paired-end reads; it is therefore not the applicable route for this dataset. A complete, haploid, single-scaffold reference genome for this exact strain (GCF_000005845.2) already exists. The RNA-Seq quantification workflow `rnaseq-pe-main` is confirmed compatible with GCF_000005845.2, with the reference genome and GTF auto-resolved by `resolve_workflow_inputs`; only the FASTQ input remains to be supplied by the user.

The IWC catalog contains exactly 1 workflow in the ASSEMBLY category, and it performs long-read polishing of an already-existing draft assembly rather than de novo genome assembly from short paired-end reads; it is therefore not the applicable route for this dataset. A complete, haploid, single-scaffold reference genome for this exact strain (GCF_000005845.2) already exists.
